provider: native Codex CLI authenticated with ChatGPT, NOT OpenAI API key
selected_reason: lowest cost available in live codex ChatGPT cached model list; gpt-5.4-mini and gpt-5.1-codex-mini rejected by ChatGPT auth
codex_tools: do not use tools requested; unexpected calls counted
fork: from 3 historical attempts (prior free model), select_next(depth)->revise third, select_next(adaptive)->independent root
iterations: continue each arm until genuine public+independent_hidden passing patch, or provider/infrastructure hard blocker (no arbitrary attempt ceiling)
Nykra_optimizations: safe AST import-only normalizer shared with baseline to isolate policy
same-arm repeated failed patch public receipt reuse; baseline direct regrade
source_validator: only one complete expected Python function; unchanged signature; allowed stdlib top-level import can be normalized for both arms
code_execution: only genuine pinned Docker public/hidden validators, no host execution of generated code
hidden_test_policy: after public pass only, no hidden diagnostics passed to models
savings_metric: actual authenticated calls and provider usage, not hypothetical sample costs
important_limit: Historical studied BugsInPy issues; prior attempts generated by different free model; no new unseen problem / large-n claim.
